name: Living Office Visual Template Memory
description: 27 reusable composition templates derived from visual references. Reference colors, logos, and copy are never copied. Brand palette and identity always come from brand memory.

feed_square.instruction: Compose as a square social feed post. Preserve the template hierarchy and keep all important content inside safe margins.

feed_portrait.instruction: Reflow the composition vertically for a portrait social feed post. Preserve the visual hierarchy and do not simply crop a square composition.

story.instruction: Recompose the same visual grammar into a vertical story. Increase vertical breathing room, stack content naturally, keep headline and focal object inside safe story areas, and do not simply stretch or crop the feed layout.

article.instruction: Recompose as a horizontal editorial article hero image. Reduce text density, move the main subject and headline into a strong horizontal composition, and preserve the original template family rather than cropping the feed.

global_rules: Use only the active brand palette supplied by brand memory.
Never copy logos, names, typography, slogans, or exact artwork from reference images.
Reference images define composition grammar only.
Replace every reference subject with a subject appropriate to the analyzed content.
Do not render large paragraphs inside the generated image.
Maintain the active brand visual personality.
Adapt layout intelligently for feed, story, and article aspect ratios.
Do not simply crop another output format.
Keep important text and subjects inside safe margins.

templates.prompt: Create a clean benefit-focused campaign for {{brand.name}} using only {{brand.palette}}. {{output.layout_instruction}} Center an open headline area near the upper area with a smaller open line below it. List three to five simple items vertically with simple plus marks, bullets or micro-icons. Add one oversized cursor, pointer, arrow or contextual object representing {{analysis.visual_subject}} near the lower edge. Strong action-oriented composition with spacious editorial layout.

layout_by_output.feed_square: Square composition: open headline area above, benefit list centered, pointer near lower edge. Keep generous safe margins and a balanced 1:1 hierarchy.
layout_by_output.feed_portrait: Portrait 4:5 composition: open headline area above, benefit list centered, pointer near lower edge; reflow with more vertical breathing room and a taller central visual. Do not crop a square image.
layout_by_output.story: Original 9:16 story composition: open headline area top, benefits stacked, pointer in lower safe area. Keep open headline area and call-to-action area in safe areas. Do not stretch or crop a feed image.
layout_by_output.article: Original 16:9 editorial hero composition: open headline area left, benefit list and pointer right. Keep the design sparse and use wide negative space. Do not crop a feed image.
